options.name: Invigorated By Wrath
options.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a FIGHT ability for a unit in combat with this unit
options.lore_text: The spray of blood over flesh sees this champion filled with new purpose.
options.effect: This unit can immediately make a pile-in move.

options.name: Blood-Blind
options.timing: Reaction: This unit was targeted by a FIGHT ability
options.lore_text: Those who attack this champion momentarily lose sight of who is friend and who is foe.
options.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, after that FIGHT ability has been resolved, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy unit using that FIGHT ability equal to the roll.

options.name: Brutal Onslaught
options.lore_text: Charging into the fray with a howl fills this champion with a wild, bloodthirsty energy.
options.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.

options.name: Dominating Powerhouse
options.lore_text: This champion is always at the front, always seeking to kill.
options.effect: This unit can move D6". It must end that move in combat.

options.name: Breaker of the Arcane
options.lore_text: This champion has hardened their soul against craven magic.
options.effect: This unit can use UNBIND abilities as if it had WIZARD (1). Each time this unit unbinds a spell, subtract 1 from the power level of the WIZARD using that SPELL ability, to a minimum of 0, for the rest of the battle.An enemy WIZARD can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

options.name: Locus of Red Devotion
options.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a PRAYER ability for a PRIEST within 12" of this unit
options.lore_text: This champion has become a prophet of war, their prayers to the War God drowning out those of any others beseeching divine aid.
options.effect: The chanting roll must be re-rolled.

options.name: Vessel of Murder
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: Khorne's elemental fury seethes through this champion, obliterating all.
options.declare: Pick all enemy units in combat with this unit to be targets.
options.effect: Roll 8 dice. For each roll of 3-5, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target. For each 6, inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

options.name: Whirlwind of Annihilation
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: Dread legends are told of this champion's murderous nature: how they kill and kill, without relent, without pity, without regard for mortal limitation.
options.effect: This unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

blades-of-khorne.name: Path of Brazen Butchery
blades-of-khorne.restricted: non-HERO BLADES OF KHORNE unit only

options.name: Shield-Breakers
options.lore_text: These warriors have a name for themselves by shattering the most determined defences.
options.effect: Enemy units in combat with this unit cannot use the ’All-out Defence’ command.

options.name: Pack of Murderers
options.lore_text: These warriors excel at surrounding and tearing apart their prey.
options.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target cannot use RETREAT abilities until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Savage Conquerors
options.lore_text: This warband is obsessed with expanding the domain of their master.
options.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit contesting an objective that you do not control.

options.name: Soul-Eating Rage
options.lore_text: Infernal power has seized these warriors, rapidly stealing their individuality while melting through nearby magical wards.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

options.name: Spell-Killers
options.lore_text: These warriors revel - and are well practised - in annihilating constructs of magic.
options.effect: Enemy MANIFESTATIONS in combat with this unit have STRIKE-LAST.

options.name: Loping Pursuit
options.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit
options.lore_text: Whether by dark blessing or sheer grit, these warriors have run down many foes.
options.effect: If the charge roll was 5 or less, you can re-roll 1 of the dice.

options.name: Infamous Warcry
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: The murder-howl of these warriors sets the blood of Khorne's followers aflame.
options.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick each friendly unit within 3" of this unit to be the targets.
options.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the result exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

options.name: Revenants in Red
options.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
options.lore_text: Many times have these warriors cheated death, and many times ought they to have fallen; they neither eat nor drink now, for blood and massacre alone sustains them.
options.effect: If any enemy units were destroyed this turn while they were in combat with this unit, Heal (X) this unit, where X is the number of damage points this unit has.

options.name: Vengeful
options.lore_text: Nothing enrages this leader more than the deaths of those under their command.
options.effect: If any friendly SIGMARITE units have been destroyed this battle, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.

options.name: To the Last
options.lore_text: Every fallen comrade seems to heighten this warrior's determination to triumph.
options.effect: While they are within 12" of this unit, subtract 2 from the control scores of visible enemy units for each friendly unit that has been destroyed this battle.

options.name: Focused Aggression
options.lore_text: This hero channels their rage into a decisive and deadly opening assault.
options.effect: You can re-roll wound rolls for combat attacks made with this unit’s non-Companion weapons if it charged in the same turn.

options.name: Wicked Cunning
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Enemy Movement Phase
options.lore_text: A wily warrior, this hero can always make sure they are in exactly the right place at the right time.
options.effect: This unit can use the 'Normal Move' or 'Run' ability as if it were your movement phase.

options.name: Patient Blade
options.lore_text: This hero and their warriors bide their time, waitingfor the perfect moment to deal a telling blow.
options.effect: For the rest of the battle, while they are wholly within 6" of this unit, other visible friendly non-HERO SIGMARITE units have STRIKE-FIRST.

options.name: Impatient Onrusher
options.lore_text: This hero surges towards the front lines in order to wreak havoc.
options.declare: Pick up to 2 other visible friendly SIGMARITE units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
options.effect: This unit and the targets can each use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase. This unit must move before any targets, and it must end that move more than 12" from all enemy units and not within enemy territory. Each target must end their move within this unit’s combat range.

options.name: Cometh the Moment
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: This warrior preserves all their strength for a single instance of glorious combat.
options.effect: This unit can use up to 3 FIGHT abilities this phase. However, after the first is used, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn, and after the second is used, allocate 6 damage points to this unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

options.name: Signature Invocation
options.lore_text: This hero has mastered a particular spell or incantation and can cast it with barely a moment's thought.
options.declare: Pick a SPELL or PRAYER ability that this unit can use.
options.effect: For the rest of the battle, this unit can use that ability in the enemy hero phase as if it were your hero phase.

cities-of-sigmar.name: Path of the Castelite
cities-of-sigmar.restricted: non-HERO SLAVES TO DARKNESS unit only

options.name: Crusaders
options.lore_text: To the beat of the drum and an upbeat tune, these soldiers eagerly march to battle.
options.effect: Add 3 to run rolls for this unit.

options.name: Blessed Blades and Runic Shot
options.lore_text: Insofar as weapons and ammunition are concerned, these warriors are equipped with the very best.
options.effect: If this unit has not used a MOVE ability this turn, this unit’s weapons have Crit (Auto-wound).

options.name: Pioneers
options.lore_text: These soldiers are at their best far from home, deep behind enemy lines.
options.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks while it is wholly within enemy territory.

options.name: Camp Defenders
options.lore_text: Through excessive drills, this unit's tightly knit shieldwall keeps enemy ranged assaults at bay.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for shooting attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within friendly territory.

options.name: Not One Step Back
options.lore_text: Famed for acts of bloody-minded stubbornness and unyielding valour, this unit would rather perish than retreat.
options.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit. Ignore modifiers (positive and negative) to save rolls for this unit. This unit cannot use RETREAT abilities.

options.name: Find the Weak Spot
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
options.lore_text: Hard-won experience has taught these warriors to seek out and target the enemy's vulnerabilities.
options.effect: For the rest of the turn, ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted on enemy units by this unit’s attacks.

options.name: Champions of Sigmar
options.timing: Reaction: This unit was picked to be the target of a SPELL or PRAYER ability.
options.lore_text: Having seen and fought all manner of unimaginable horrors, these stalwarts have the blessing of the God-King.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:That ability has no effect on this unit.This unit has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Decisive Strikes
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: These warriors sense an opportunity for carnage, and their attacks become almost wild in their intensity.
options.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Bloodmad
options.lore_text: A vicious zealot, this leader is driven into a frenzy by the sight of blood. Their own, the enemy's, their allies': it is all the same.
options.effect: While this unit is within 3" of any visible damaged units (friendly or enemy), add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with th is unit’s melee weapons.

options.name: Screeching Evangelist
options.lore_text: This hero urges their followers to acts of bloodshed in Morathi's name.
options.declare: Pick a visible friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Lethal Blademistress
options.lore_text: Few would dare question this champion's skill with a blade after witnessing her take apart an opponent.
options.effect: Attacks made with this unit’s melee weapons score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

options.name: Ear-Bursting Shriek
options.lore_text: This hero's screams shred the eardrums of those they are directed at.
options.declare: Pick a visible enemy HERO within 10" of th is unit to be the target.
options.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll and the ta rget has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Blade of Shadow
options.lore_text: This wispy blade sinks straight through armour; hungrily seeking flesh.
options.effect: The Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons is equal to the current battle round number, unless it would be higher.

options.name: Flickering Blur
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: This warrior is so blindingly fast that they seem to be invulnerable.
options.effect: This unit has WARD (3+) for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Bellowed Exhortations
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
options.lore_text: This hero's booming voice drives Khainites into an ecstatic frenzy.
options.declare: Pick a visible fr iendly non-HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the ta rget.
options.effect: If you have used the ‘Blessings of Khaine’ ability 3 or more times th is battle, the target’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 4+ for the rest of the turn. Otherwise, roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the current battle round number, the target’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 4+ for the rest of the tu rn.

options.name: Blessed of the Goddess
options.lore_text: This champion has an affinity for Morathi's beloved manifestations.
options.declare: Pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE MANIFESTATION that is not on the battlefield.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, if you picked a Heart of Fury, set it up wholly within 18" of this unit and visible to it. Otherwise, on a 4+, set up the MANIFESTATION wholly within 12" of this unit, visible to it and more than 9" from all enemy units. This unit has summoned that MANIFESTATION.

daughters-of-khaine.name: Path of the Blood Witch
daughters-of-khaine.restricted: non-HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit only

options.name: Lethal Grace
options.lore_text: These Khainites move with exceptional celerity and acrobatic dexterity.
options.effect: Add 2 to run rolls for this unit.

options.name: Ferocious and Fearless
options.lore_text: This unit hurls itself into combat with reckless abandon.
options.effect: Add 3 to this unit’s control score if it charged in the same turn.

options.name: Shield of Blades
options.lore_text: These warriors have suchunnaturally swift reactions that they can deflectincoming missiles out of the air with their blades.
options.effect: Shooting attacks that target th is unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead). If the unmodified hit roll for a shooting attack that targets this unit is 6, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

options.name: A Thousand Cuts
options.lore_text: Quick, precise cuts bleed monstrous foes, sapping their strength and hastening their doom.
options.declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll and the target cannot use RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Shadow-Blessed
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
options.lore_text: Whether covered in tattoos inked in Ulguan blood or wearing cloaks of shadow, these warriors are one with the darkness.
options.effect: Remove th is unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than X" from all enemy units, where X is equal to 10 minus the current battle round number.

options.name: First Blood
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: Few foes react to danger more swiftly than a Khainite aelf.
options.effect: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Fangs of the Viper
options.lore_text: Their weapons dipped in the venom of Ulguan pit-adders, the merest slice from these warriors can kill painfully.
options.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this unit’s attacks.

options.name: Fleet-Footed Killers
options.lore_text: These warriors seem to glide across the ground, so quickly do they cover the distance between them and their prey.
options.effect: Add 4" to this unit's Move characteristic.

options.name: Spell Jaunt
options.lore_text: Sapping a manifestation’s energy, the hero transposes their physical form across reality.
options.effect: When using the ‘Smoke and Mirrors’ ability, if this unit is masked by illusion, you can pick a MANIFESTATION (friendly or enemy) that was not set up in the same turn to be the target instead. If you do so, you must pick this unit to be the substitute. After setting up the substitute, the target is banished instead of being set up in reserve.

options.name: Master of Misdirection
options.lore_text: This warrior easily redirects incoming attacks, using their minions as a distraction.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit while it is within the combat range of another friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit.

options.name: Stream of Babble
options.lore_text: This warrior’s constant babbling interferes with their enemy’s magic.
options.effect: Add 1 to unbinding rolls for this unit.

options.name: Agent of Change
options.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
options.lore_text: This hero delights in corrupting pure and untouched lands.
options.effect: If this unit is contesting an objective you do not control, gain 1 fate point.

options.name: Splinter Spell
options.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a Spell ability for this unit
options.lore_text: The caster’s conjuration splits mid-cast, zipping off in multiple directions.
options.effect: If that spell is successfully cast, roll a dice. On a 4+, after resolving the effect of that spell, this unit can immediately cast that spell a second time using the same casting roll. Do not count the second spell towards the number of Spell abilities this unit can use this turn.

options.name: Driven By Fate
options.lore_text: This hero’s weapon moves of its own accord, guided not by strength but by destiny.
options.effect: While you have 3 or more fate points, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks. While you have 6 or more fate points, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks. While you have 9 or more fate points, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

options.name: Concealed Sorcery
options.lore_text: Disguised by illusion, the sorcerer hurls a spell from an unexpected angle.
options.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is masked by illusion. Pick a model in a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit to be the target.
options.effect: This unit can immediately use a SPELL ability. When it does so, measure the range and visibility of that SPELL ability from the target.

options.name: Eldritch Coven
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
options.lore_text: This hero has formed an eldritch pact with fellow sorcerers, combining their powers to malevolent ends.
options.effect: Each visible friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD wholly within 12" of this unit can use a Spell ability as if it were your hero phase.

disciples-of-tzeentch.name: Path of Mutation
disciples-of-tzeentch.restricted: non-HERO DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit only

options.name: Silver Skin
options.lore_text: These warriors’flesh has turned to gleaming metal that deflects missiles and blades.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit in the first battle round.

options.name: Bird-Like Limbs
options.lore_text: The reverse-jointed limbs of these warriors grant them extraordinary speed.
options.effect: Add 2 to run rolls for this unit.

options.name: Telepathic Link
options.lore_text: These warriors use a psychic connection to request aid from nearby mages.
options.declare: Pick a visible friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
options.effect: The target can use an additional SPELL ability this turn, but this unit must be picked to be the target of that spell.

options.name: Crown of Wyrdflame
options.lore_text: A corona of corrupting fire causes nearby foes to burst into flames.
options.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
options.effect: Roll 9 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

options.name: Temporal Distortion
options.lore_text: Slipping in and out of time, these warriors bypass their enemy’s defences.
options.effect: If this unit was set up this turn, it can move D3". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

options.name: Inhuman Reflexes
options.lore_text: These warriors move with unnatural swiftness, anticipating their foe’s attacks.
options.effect: This unit has WARD (5+) if it was set up in the same turn.

options.name: DoppelgÄNger
options.lore_text: These warriors have divided their consciousness between multiple identical forms.
options.effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) in reserve masked by illusion.

options.name: Quicksilver Blood
options.lore_text: Boiling metal runs in the veins of these warriors.
options.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain, before removing the model from play, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

options.name: Skill-At-Arms
options.lore_text: This creature retains some vestige of martial prowess.
options.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.

options.name: Unnatural Parry
options.lore_text: Whipcord-fast and cunning, this creature bats away enemy blows.
options.effect: Combat attacks that target this unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

options.name: Unnatural Wards
options.lore_text: No foul sorcery or spellcraft may harm this most 'saintly' of champions.
options.effect: This unit has WARD (4+) against damage points inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.

options.name: Unholy Thirst
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
options.lore_text: Battle stokes this ghoul's fury.
options.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons, including Companion weapons, for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Let Us Break Bread!
options.lore_text: Something in this creature's gibbering howls still seizes enemies in a hypnotic bind.
options.effect: Enemy units cannot use RETREAT abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

options.name: Glorious Charge
options.lore_text: A true ruler knows that their place is at the tip of the lance.
options.effect: When making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

options.name: Regal Authority
options.timing: Once Per Turn (Army) Reaction: Opponent declared a CHARGE ability for an enemy unit within 12" of this unit
options.lore_text: A true royal may be approached only when they desire it ...
options.effect: You and your opponent must roll off. If you roll higher, subtract 3 from the charge roll. If your roll is at least double your opponent’s roll, pick 1 dice in the charge roll instead. Your opponent must remove that dice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

options.name: Beloved of the Kingdom
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
options.lore_text: Serfs and champions of all kinds rise up at this ghoul's word.
options.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE FLESH-EATER COURTS unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
options.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

options.name: Roving Pack
options.lore_text: Whether they see themselves as outlaws, mercenaries or travelling war-troubadours, these ghouls are used to crossing long distances fast.
options.effect: If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit can move 3". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

options.name: Sentries-At-Arms
options.lore_text: These ghouls vigilantly keep the borders of the kingdom, repelling trespassers.
options.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target that enemy unit.

options.name: Culinary Artistes
options.lore_text: A stint in the monarch's kitchens have made these ghouls expert flesh-slicers.
options.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit and that have any damage points allocated to them to be the targets.
options.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on each target.

options.name: One with the Land
options.lore_text: Royal gamekeepers and scouts, these ghouls are naturally talented at blending into the terrain.
options.effect: While this unit is wholly within 3" of a terrain feature, it is not visible to enemy units more than 6" away.

options.name: Guards of the Royal Menagerie
options.lore_text: These ghouls are skilled in dealing with savage beasts.
options.effect: Subtract 2 from the Damage characteristic of Companion weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

options.name: Glory Or Death
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: Battle is all to these ghouls.
options.effect: For the rest of the turn:Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons, including Companion weapons.This unit cannot contest objectives.

options.name: Royal Elite
options.lore_text: These ghouls stand amongst the finest warriors of the kingdom.
options.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).

options.name: Famed Pilgrims
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
options.lore_text: With each new night, more cannibals swarm to join these zealous champions.
options.effect: Return D6 slain models to this unit.

options.name: Tough Git
options.lore_text: This cranky and calloused git is known to be a right tough 'un.
options.effect: Add 1 to this unit's Health characteristic.

options.name: Extra Stabby
options.lore_text: This git has looted the pointiest weapon they could find.
options.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits).

options.name: Frothing Enthusiasm
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
options.lore_text: This git's fanatical fervour to get stabbing as quickly as possible is infectious.
options.effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

options.name: Scale-Splitter
options.lore_text: Beasts recoil in fear at thisgit's glowering stare.
options.effect: This unit cannot be picked to be the target of RAMPAGE abilities used by enemy units.

options.name: Almost Blessed By the Bad Moon
options.lore_text: This git tells anyone that will listen that they've beenblessed by the Bad Moon, and somehow they seem to emerge from every fight unscathed. Right up until the moment they don't.
options.effect: This unit has WARD (3+). After the first failed ward roll made for it, however, it has WARD (6+) instead.

options.name: Sadistik Scoundrel
options.lore_text: This git loves to put the knife into a wounded enemy - and then gives it a good twist just to make sure.
options.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn to be the targets.
options.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

options.name: The Angriest Git Around
options.lore_text: This git's temperament is extremely volatile, and no other git wants to be seen to be running away while the boss is doing 'boss stuff'.
options.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of all friendly units while this unit is contesting an objective.

options.name: Sneaky Sidestepper
options.lore_text: This git is so crafty that their enemies' attacks often seem to strike thin air.
options.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the target’s weapons and subtract 3 from its Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Fungus Brew
options.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a non-FIGHT ability for a MANIFESTATION
options.lore_text: These warriors have perfected a fungus brew that protects them from sentient magical manifestations.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

options.name: Notorious and Vicious
options.lore_text: The backstabbing intimidation tactics of these warriors are infamous among their fellow gitz.
options.effect: Subtract 2 from the control scores of enemy units while they are contesting the same objective as this unit.

options.name: Fungal Freaks
options.lore_text: Before battle, these warriors apply cave moulds to their bodies that give off obscuring spore clouds.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

options.name: Devious Survivors
options.lore_text: If the fight isn't in the favour of these warriors, they instinctively know when they should get out of trouble.
options.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by RETREAT abilities.

options.name: Loon Crew
options.lore_text: These warriors have survived at least one battle and are now filled with the belief that the Bad Moon has blessed them with invincibility.
options.effect: This unit has WARD (6+). If this unit already has WARD (6+), it has WARD (5+) instead.

options.name: Hit 'Em Back
options.lore_text: These extremely vindictive gitz make sure that insults never go unanswered.
options.effect: Each time the unmodified save roll for a combat attack that targets this unit is 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

options.name: Stab 'Em Again and Again
options.lore_text: These vicious gitz are relentless as they plunge knives into flesh and club their enemies into the ground.
options.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s non-Companion melee weapons.

options.name: Nasty Press Gang
options.lore_text: These gitz go to great lengths to get others to 'join da ranks'. It's hard to say no when the boss's goons are looming over you...

options.name: Hit Da Dirt!
