options.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of ranged weapons used for shooting attacks that target this unit.

options.name: Feigned Flight
options.lore_text: 'It ain't runnin' away if ya turn around and stab 'em again...'
options.effect: This unit can use a RUN ability and still use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities later In the same turn.

options.name: Let's Get 'Em, Boss!
options.lore_text: These ladz feel considerably more secure when skulking about in the shadow of their boss.
options.effect: While any friendly INFANTRY HEROES are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those INFANTRY HEROES have WARD (5+).

options.name: We'll Look After Disi
options.lore_text: Having convinced their boss they're the best at bringing up the rear, these orruks aren't about to embarras themselves by letting the boss down.
options.effect: While each model in this unit is contesting an objective you control, add 1 to save rolls for this unit.

options.name: Practically Gorkish
options.lore_text: These ladz love to get stuck in, and their entusiasm for Gorkish, krumpin' is practically infectious to their fellow Kruleboyz.
options.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly non-HERO INFANTRY units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.

options.name: Cull 'Em All
options.lore_text: By using tricksy traps and vicious violence, these orruks can quickly butcher even overbearing numbers.
options.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit that has 5 or more models.

options.name: Precision Strikes
options.lore_text: This hero’s combat form is impeccable and unerring.
options.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.

options.name: Unravel Magic
options.lore_text: This hero is a master of arcane defence who has studiously examined the magical abilities of the foe, the better to foil them.
options.effect: Add 1 to unbinding rolls for this unit.

options.name: Fleet and Deft
options.lore_text: This nimble hero is difficult to pin down, darting in and out of combat with near impunity.
options.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6". It can pass through enemy models during that move.

options.name: Steady Mind
options.timing: Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for this unit
options.lore_text: The subconscious of this hero is a vista of infinite calm that proves a vital refuge when the utmost focus is paramount.
options.effect: Re-roll 1 of the dice in the casting roll.

options.name: Display of Prowess
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: When the need is great, this champion rises to the occasion, dispatchingfoe after foe in an awesome display of skill.
options.effect: This unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Enlightening Presence
options.lore_text: Erudition is this hero’s hallmark. Their knowledge of matters both physical and arcane is invaluable to their allies.
options.effect: While friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units are wholly within 12" of this unit, add 1 to casting rolls for those units and add 1 to wound rolls for those units’ attacks.

options.name: Icon of Valour
options.lore_text: Their name now legendary among the Lumineth, any aelf of Hysh would be honoured to charge alongside this hero into battle.
options.declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 other friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units wholly within 12’ of this unit to be the targets.
options.effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for the target(s), add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

options.name: Ascended Form
options.lore_text: When this hero is finally struck down, cleansing light erupts from their perished physical shell and their spirit fights on.
options.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, it is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (1) this unit and for the rest of the battle:Ignore modifiers (positive and negative) to save rolls and ward rolls for this unit.This unit has WARD (4+) and FLY.This unit cannot be healed.

options.name: Fleet-Footed
options.timing: Reaction: You declared the ‘Run’ ability for this unit
options.lore_text: These warriors have undergone lengthy inarching drills and athletic training, granting them that extra bit of speed and stamina.
options.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

options.name: Courageous Resolve
options.lore_text: Once these warriors have committed to holding ground, there are few who can match their bold determination.
options.effect: Add 5 to this unit’s control score while each model in this unit is contesting an objective you control.

options.name: Realmshift
options.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
options.lore_text: Whether by a memorised minor spell of travel or the aid of nearby realm spirits, these warriors are able to reposition with sudden speed regardless of obstacles.
options.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

options.name: Unshakeable Focus
options.lore_text: Even in the midst of a confused melee, little can distract these warriors in their attempts to slay their opponents.
options.effect: Ignore the effects of STRIKE-LAST on this unit.

options.name: Balanced Manoeuvres
options.lore_text: The ebb and flow of the currents, the rise and fall of the hammer: these warriors have long studied the art of the force applied and then denied.
options.effect: This unit can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by RETREAT abilities.

options.name: Artisan Armour
options.lore_text: Such is the outstanding calibre of these warriors that their commander commissioned for them armour of the highest calibre.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

options.name: Blinding Brilliance
options.lore_text: From a distance, these warriors appear as a shimmering aurora, making it difficult for enemy missile troops to target them with any precision.
options.effect: This unit cannot be picked to be the target of abilities used by enemy units that are more than 9" away from it.

options.name: Sworn Defenders
options.lore_text: Perhaps these warriors are aelementiri sworn to guard their patron spirit, or perhaps they are the bodyguard of a renowned mage. Whatever the case, their comrades are truly blessed to benefit from their selflessness and skill.
options.effect: While this unit is wholly within the combat range of another friendly unit, both this unit and that friendly unit have WARD (5+).

options.name: Bloated and Brutal
options.lore_text: This Nurglite is a disease-swollen monstrosity with incredible strength.
options.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.

options.name: Foul Stench
options.lore_text: A stinking fug envelops this hero.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy non-HERO units while they are in combat with this unit.

options.name: Irrepressible Momentum
options.lore_text: This flushed warrior lurches into battle in a feverish frenzy.
options.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can make a pile-in move.

options.name: Oozy
options.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a RETREAT ability for a unit in combat with this unit
options.lore_text: There is no escaping this hero’s caustic ooze.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll after the RETREAT ability has been resolved.

options.name: Afflicted in Arms
options.lore_text: The diseases spread by this hero maintain a strange link to their originator.
options.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
options.effect: For the rest of the battle, each time the target uses a command, after resolving that command or the ability it was a reaction to, Heal (D3) this unit.

options.name: Viscous Phlegm
options.lore_text: Spitting forth slimy mucus, this warrior binds their enemies in stringy matter.
options.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 3 from charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Risen From Disease
options.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
options.lore_text: Sickness invigorates this hero. Even death has no hold over them.
options.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed. Pick this unit to be the target, then pick a DISEASED enemy HERO to be the incubator.
options.effect: You and your opponent must roll off. Add the targets Control characteristic to your roll and add the incubator’s Control characteristic to your opponent’s roll. If your roll equals or exceeds your opponent’s, set up a replacement unit for the target with 4 damage points allocated to it within 3" of the incubator. Then, if your roll is at least double your opponent’s, the incubator is automatically destroyed.

options.name: The Foulness That Lurks Within
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: This hero harbours an unnameable contagion that slows the body and makes limbs leaden.
options.declare: Pick each DISEASED enemy unit on the battlefield to be the targets.
options.effect: The targets have STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

maggotkin-of-nurgle.name: Path of the Foetid Disciples
maggotkin-of-nurgle.restricted: non-HERO MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE unit only

options.name: Repulsive Grins
options.lore_text: It is hard to concentrate on complex tasks when faced with rows of wormy teeth.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units while they are within 7" of this unit.

options.name: Mildew-Encrusted
options.timing: Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a SHOOT ability
options.lore_text: Coated in a foul, fungal growth, these warriors are surprisingly resilient.
options.effect: Ignore the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks made as part of that SHOOT ability.

options.name: Loathsome Fortitude
options.lore_text: Virulent and untiring, these warriors are dogged in their pursuit of claiming territory.
options.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks while each model in this unit is contesting an objective.

options.name: Horrific Mutations
options.lore_text: Protruding horns and gnashing maws enhance these warriors’ lethality.
options.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2-5, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict 2 mortal damage on the target.

options.name: Contagious to Living Magic
options.lore_text: The taint of these warriors even affects the arcane.
options.effect: Enemy MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up within 12" of this unit and cannot pass through or end a move within this unit’s combat range unless they started that move within this unit’s combat range.

options.name: Reek of Mediocrity
options.lore_text: Even legendary weapons are rendered depressingly mundane when they strike the clammy grey hides of these moribund warriors.
options.effect: Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target this unit have no effect.

options.name: Grasping Tentacles
options.lore_text: These warriors possess multiple writhing, slime-slick tendrils.
options.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Move characteristic, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Mimetic Parasites
options.lore_text: The parasites that infest these warriors writhe into life when nearby foes make a concerted effort, imbuing their hosts with the same determination and vigour.
options.effect: Each time an enemy unit in combat with this unit uses the 'All-out Defence' or 'All-out Attack' command, the effect of that command also applies to this unit for the rest of the phase.

options.name: Justice of Death
options.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
options.lore_text: This gheist zealously demands their enemies face Nagash's judgement, threatening dire punishments for those who resist.
options.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be an accused unit for the rest of the battle.
options.effect: The next time that accused unit uses a CORE ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on it after that ability is resolved.

options.name: Marked for Capture
options.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
options.lore_text: This gheist savours the misery of those whose souls it has been charged with delivering to the underworlds.
options.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be an accused unit for the rest of the battle.
options.effect: If that accused unit is destroyed while it is in combat with this unit, add 5 to this unit’s control score for the rest of the battle.

options.name: Malignant Prosecutor
options.lore_text: This gheist screeches the guilt of those nearby for all to hear, drowning them in memories laden with regret.
options.effect: Enemy units in combat with this unit cannot use commands.

options.name: Marked for Capture
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
options.lore_text: An atavistic terror overcomes those who behold this tormented wretch.
options.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is in combat with this unit to be the target.
options.effect: The target must use a RETREAT ability in the following movement phase if possible.

options.name: Grim Judge
options.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
options.lore_text: With the weight of Nagash's divine authority behind them, this gheist can influence what punishment will befall the victim after death.
options.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit, and each accused enemy unit within 12" of this unit, to be the targets.
options.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the targets for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Shackled Gaoler
options.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: Spectral chains explode from this gheist, dragging the living to their doom.
options.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this unit, and each accused enemy unit within 12" of this unit, to be the targets.
options.effect: For each target, after it makes a pile-in move this phase, roll 2 D3s. For each 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

options.name: Pronounce Sentence
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
options.lore_text: The final sentencing of the accused promises an eternity of pain and suffering can chill even the bravest soul.
options.effect: For the rest of the turn, accused units’ Path abilities are ignored.

options.name: Soul-Splitting Wail
options.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
options.lore_text: A scream of lethal despondency issues from this gheist's distended jaws.
options.effect: Inflict X mortal damage on each enemy unit within 6" of this unit, where X is equal to the totalled negative modifiers to that enemy unit’s control score.

options.name: Wrathful Scourging
options.lore_text: Spectral whips follow these gheists, each lash crafted from motes of Nagash's cold fury for the sins they committed against him during their life.
options.effect: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.

options.name: Fresh From Nagashizzar
options.lore_text: These gheists care nothing for the wittering of the hated living.
options.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to this unit’s control score.

options.name: Dutiful Penitents
options.timing: Reaction: You declared a command for this unit
options.lore_text: These minions know that only fresh punishment awaits those who shirk their duty in the face of their masters.
options.effect: Return 1 slain model to this unit.

options.name: Blades of Black Souls
options.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: These malignant blades are crafted from the most evil souls caught in Nagash's cold grasp, and they have a deep-seated hatred of his foes.
options.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's weapons for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Spectral Lampreys
options.lore_text: Gently glowing tendrils that emanate from these Nighthaunt wrap themselves around their foes' weapons and limbs, draining them of their strength.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for melee attacks that target this unit.

options.name: Dark Flames
options.lore_text: These cursed souls bear a terrible burden, flickering with flames that burn the souls of not just those around them but themselves as well.
options.effect: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit in combat with this unit. Allocate a number of damage points to that enemy unit equal to the roll (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

options.name: Immortal Horrors
options.lore_text: Screaming in such agony that it irreversibly scars the souls of any who hear it, there are few who can do more than recoil in terror in proximity to these malignant revenants.
options.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

options.name: Always Snacking
options.lore_text: Being embroiled in the white heat of melee is no reason to stop feasting, so says this ogor - quite the opposite, in fact.
options.effect: If this unit is in combat, Heal (1) this unit.

options.name: A Strange and Squirming Power
options.lore_text: For whatever reason, magic itself seems reluctant to come too close to this ogor.
options.effect: This unit has WARD (5+) against damage points inflicted by SPELL and PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.

options.name: Hungry for Trouble
options.lore_text: Stay back to lead the mobs, or charge ahead to get stuck in: for this ogor, the choice is clear.
options.effect: This hero can move up to 6".

options.name: Ravenous Phenomena
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Shooting Phase
options.lore_text: This ogor claims that the Gulping God favours them, opening sinkholes to swallow enemies wherever they go.
options.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

options.name: Reality-Warping Belches
options.lore_text: As comical as it is to their ogor mates, the gut-rumbles of this chieftain seem to shake the laws of the cosmos.
options.declare: Pick either each enemy MANIFESTATION or each enemy faction terrain feature to be the targets.
options.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

options.name: Shadow of the Hungering One
options.lore_text: Mystical foes perceive this ogor with dread, seeing within their soul the echo of an insatiable entity...
options.effect: While this hero is in combat with an enemy WIZARD, the following effects apply:Subtract 1 from that enemy WIZARD’s power level, to a minimum of 0.Add 1 to this unit’s power level, or, if this unit is not a WIZARD or PRIEST, it has WIZARD (1).

options.name: Bloody-Mawed Chieftain
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: Many a violent feasting song speaks to the red-handed acts of destruction committed by this ogor.
options.effect: This unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Monstrous Momentum
options.lore_text: Like a boulder rolling downhill, this ogor stomps on and on without ever relenting.
options.effect: This unit can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

options.name: Hulking Heavyweights
options.lore_text: These ogors have already gained noticeable bulk - enough to give even monsters pause.
options.effect: Enemy MONSTERS cannot use RAMPAGE abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

options.name: Reinforced Scrap
options.lore_text: These ogors have incorporated all sorts of eclectic materials into their gear: stolen gromril, stripped ironoak - even bits of Stonehorn skeleton.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for shooting attacks that target this unit.

options.name: Terrifying Tramplers
options.lore_text: Tales are spreading of the... ‘forthright’ tactics used by these warriors on the charge.
options.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

options.name: First to the Plunder
options.lore_text: These warriors are firm believers in the old ogor adage that a bit of vigour in your step gets you the pick of the loot.
options.effect: You can re-roll run rolls for this unit.

options.name: Brutish Bellowers
options.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit in combat with this unit
options.lore_text: In battle these ogors give voice to all sorts of chants, ranging from guttural to threatening to bawdy, to terrify their enemies. None of them are in tune.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost.

options.name: Quick Thinking (For Ogors)
options.lore_text: Experience has given these ogors an eye for opportunities - even if they are mostly opportunities for more carnage...
options.effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can immediately use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.

options.name: Frenzied Feasters
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: Other ogors mutter in awe of the murderous hunger-frenzy that seizes these ogors in battle, how the scent of blood alone sends them wild and feral.
options.effect: If this unit charged this turn, it has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

options.name: The Scars to Prove It
options.lore_text: Victors of a hundred raids and battles, these infamous ogors mark their toughness by their many wounds.
options.effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used for combat attacks that target this unit.

options.name: Ambitious Duellist
options.lore_text: This hero seeks to prove Their superiority over all other foes of renown.
options.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy HERO. In addition, if that HERO is on a Path and has a higher rank than this unit, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target that HERO.

options.name: Scholar of the Deathly Arts
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: This hero has spent long centuries perfecting their death-based magics.
options.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

options.name: Dead Good
options.lore_text: This hero is animated by souls from some of the mightiest warrior-lodges in the Shyishan underworlds.
options.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, or 1 wound roll, or 1 save roll for this unit.

options.name: Obsessively Studious
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
options.lore_text: Secrets revealed to this scholar are known by a mere handful of souls.
options.declare: Pick a non-SUMMON SPELL ability that this unit can use.
options.effect: For the rest of the phase, this un it can use that ability as if it had the UNLIMITED keyword.

options.name: Aura of the Nadir
options.lore_text: The necrotic energy emanatingfrom this hero drains the enemy's strength.
options.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Necromantic Prodigies
options.lore_text: The souls of highly successful necromancers were ground down into spiritual gristle and used as clay to create this construct's mighty soul.
options.effect: Add 1 to this unit’s power level.

options.name: Single-Minded Ruthlessness
options.lore_text: The necrotic energy emanatingfrom this hero drains the enemy's strength.
options.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons. All of this unit’s attacks this turn must target the same enemy unit.

options.name: Master of the Mortisan Caste
options.lore_text: This scholar's knowledge of deathly soul-magics and bonecraft is without compare.
options.effect: Each time a casting roll is made for this unit, you can re-roll any of the dice.

options.name: Steady March
options.lore_text: These soldiers march in eerie but swift lockstep.
options.effect: Add 1" to this unit's Move characteristic.

options.name: Necrotic Charge
options.lore_text: This unit is invigorated by the motes of death around them.
options.effect: Each time this unit makes a pile-in move, add 3" to the distance it can move.

options.name: Unfaltering Defenders
options.lore_text: Little escapes the notice of these ever-vigilant guardians, and fewer still can shift them from their allotted protectorate.
options.effect: Double this unit’s control score while it is contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

options.name: Empowered Nadirite
options.lore_text: This unit's blades all but seethe with necromantic energy.
options.effect: This unit’s weapons have Crit (2 Hits).

options.name: Emotionless Ferocity
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: Though they attack in a near frenzy, this unit's features remain as cold and impassive as a newly polished gravestone.
options.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Inexhaustible and Undefeatable
options.lore_text: To wage war upon these warriors is to experience the full might of the endless Ossiarch legions.
options.effect: If this unit has a Health characteristic of 1, return D3 slain models to it. Otherwise, Heal (3) this unit.

options.name: Invincible Legionaries
options.lore_text: So few are the enemies that can bring these warriors down that their durability is now the very stuff of legend.
options.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit.

options.name: Immortal Contempt
options.lore_text: These warriors treat those who would impede the march of the Ossiarchs with disdain, effortlessly swatting them away.
options.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks.

options.name: Touched By Warpstone
options.lore_text: Exposure to warpstone has granted this Skaven a strange vitality.
options.effect: Add 1 to this unit’s Health characteristic.

options.name: Truly Ravenous
options.lore_text: The black hunger causes this Skaven to throw caution to the wind in order to feed.
options.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.

options.name: Subtle Tactician
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
options.lore_text: This chief drills the swarm in manoeuvres to lessen the impact of missile fire.
options.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for ranged attacks that target friendly SKAVEN units wholly within 12" of this unit.

options.name: Vermindoom Vanguard
options.lore_text: Having fought on the front lines of the Skaven invasion, this ratman takes joy in tearing down the forces of civilisation.
options.effect: This unit’s non-Companion melee weapons have Anti-ORDER (+1 Rend).

options.name: Escape Artist
options.lore_text: After a lifetime spent navigating the treacherous warreus of Blight City, this Skaven is no stranger to evading assailants or backstabbers.
options.effect: You can re-roll ward rolls of 1 or 2 for this unit.

options.name: Poison-Tipped Caltrops
options.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
options.lore_text: This chieftain's minions use devious weapons to catch foes unawares.
options.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly SKAVEN units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.
options.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time an enemy unit uses a CHARGE ability and ends the move within l" of any of the targets, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal lo the roll after the CHARGE ability has been resolved.

options.name: Choking Fumes
options.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: The fog around this chieftain can see enemies descend into violent coughing fits.
options.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, subtract 2 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Tear-Tear Them Apart
options.lore_text: This Skaven is feared by enemies and underlings alike for their aggression, flying into a frenzy at the first whiff of blood.
options.effect: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST if it charged in the same turn.

options.name: Scurrying Menace
options.lore_text: Through luck or judgement, this pack always seems to end up in the right place to strike.
options.effect: When this unit uses the ’Always Three Clawsteps Ahead’ ability, add 2" to the Move characteristic of this unit for that move.

options.name: Merciless Raiders
options.lore_text: Having cut their fangs in the first battles of the great Skaven assault, this pack excels in taking the fight to the foe.
options.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks while it is wholly within enemy territory if it charged in the same turn.

options.name: More Where They Came From
options.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
options.lore_text: Having absorbed numerous packs over the years, this formation seems to have almost endless numbers.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, you can either return up to 3 slain models with a Health characteristic of 1 to this unit or return l slain model with a Health characteristic of up to 4 to this unit.

options.name: Fleet of Claw
options.lore_text: Speed has proven to be the most effective weapon in this pack's arsenal, seeing them pounce without mercy on vulnerable prey.
options.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit if it was set up on the battlefield in the same turn.

options.name: Obscenely Good Fortune
options.lore_text: Somehow, the warriors of this pack always seem to emerge from danger largely unscathed. Other Skaven find it infuriating.
options.effect: This unit has WARD (5+).

options.name: Vicious Reputation
options.lore_text: Fearful tales of this pack's battle-frenzy and ruthlessness carry through the tunnels of Skavendom.
options.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks if it charged this turn.

options.name: Warp Stone-Infused Weapons
options.lore_text: Through canny deal-making or judicious looting, this pack has managed to secure blades empowered by evil warpstone shards.
options.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).

options.name: Mindless and Rabid
options.lore_text: Stoked into a frenzy by the shrieking of their superiors, these Skaven barely feel the bite of their enemies' weapons.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within 12" of a friendly SKAVEN HERO.

options.name: Marked for Greatness
options.lore_text: It is said this warrior bears the favour of their patron.
options.effect: This unit has WARD (6+). In addition, each time an unmodified ward roll of 6 is made for this unit, Heal (1) this unit.

options.name: Daemonic Pact
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: Power, but at what cost?
options.effect: Roll a D3. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on this unit equal to the roll. Then, pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons and add the result to its Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Not to Be Denied
options.lore_text: With honed battle instincts, this warrior is always found right where the fighting is thickest.
options.effect: If this unit is within 6" of any enemy units but not in combat, this unit can make a move of D6".

options.name: Dark Immortality
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
options.lore_text: Now a pawn in the Great Game, not even death ends this one's servitude.
options.declare: This unit can use this ability if it has been destroyed.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 6, set up a replacement unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

options.name: Molten Goreblade
options.lore_text: This Khorne-blessed weapon looses gouts of sizzling gore when it is swung.
options.effect: Each time a hit roll for a combat attack made for this unit scores a critical hit, you can pick an enemy unit within 8" of this unit to be the target. If you do so, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after that FIGHT ability has been resolved.

options.name: Exhilarating Speed
options.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit
options.lore_text: Now a pawn in the Great Game, not even death ends this one's servitude.
options.effect: Change one of the dice in the charge roll to a 6.

options.name: Bountiful Flesh
options.lore_text: Said to be blessed by Nurgle, this warrior is so replete with mutations of the flesh that landing a mortal blow upon them is nigh impossible.
options.effect: Subtract 2 from the Damage characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

options.name: Fated Champion
options.lore_text: The Change God is said to have glimpsed greatness in this one's future.
options.effect: Roll 3 dice. During the battle, instead of making a roll from the list below for this unit, you can spend 1 of these dice. The roll you would have made is replaced with the roll on the dice you spend:Hit rollsWound rollsSave rolls

slaves-to-darkness.name: Path of Ambition
slaves-to-darkness.restricted: non-HERO SLAVES TO DARKNESS unit only

options.name: Conquerors for Chaos
options.lore_text: These warriors now lead the spearhead of their warlord's advancing army, laying claim to new territories as they march.
options.effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, add 1 to this unit’s control score for this unit for the rest of the battle (this effect is cumulative).

options.name: Aspiring Warriors
options.lore_text: The glory of recently won victories has caught the attention of one of the Chaos Gods, and it is said they now call upon them for a measure of protection in battle.
options.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit has WARD (6+).

options.name: The Dread Hosts March
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Charge Phase
options.lore_text: The path behind these warriors is littered with the dead. Now, nothing can keep them from the hunt and their insatiable thirst for blood.
options.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

options.name: Bulwarks of Black Iron
options.lore_text: Many foolish foes have met their demise upon the shields and blades of these warriors, who can endure even the strongest enemy charges.
options.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend).

options.name: Ferrium Plate
options.lore_text: The Iron Golem smiths of Cham on forged the armour worn by these mighty warriors, and even the strongest blows glance off its surface.
options.effect: Each phase, the first damage point inflicted on this unit is ignored.

options.name: Bringers of Ruin
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: These warriors can call upon a diabolical battle fury that seems them lay waste to any who dare oppose them.
options.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Godmarked Warriors
options.lore_text: After dozens of victories won in the service of Chaos, these legendary warriorshave caught the attention of the Dark Gods, who bestow powerful boons upon them.
options.effect: Pick one of the Pledge to Chaos keywords for this unit to have for the rest of the battle.

options.name: Brash
options.lore_text: Not even the strongest souls want to tussle with certain gargants.
options.effect: Add 3 to this unit’s control score.

options.name: Hop, Skip and a Jump
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
options.lore_text: Many gargants won’t let anything slow them down.
options.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can pass through models in non-MONSTER units and parts of terrain features that are less than 4" tall.

options.name: Careful Lobbing
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Shooting Phase
options.lore_text: There’s nothing quite like a well-aimed boulder to the head.
options.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Toughing It Out
options.lore_text: For some gargants, looking weak is worse than any actual wound.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for shooting attacks that target this unit.

options.name: Brutal Beatdown
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: Messing with gargants usually results in the instigator being battered to a bloody pulp.
options.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Smack Talk
options.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: Gargants look down on anyone smaller than them – and with good reason.
options.declare: Pick an enemy non-MONSTER unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Galloping Lout
options.lore_text: When a fight’s brewing, this gargant’s never far away.
options.effect: You can re-roll run rolls for this unit.

options.name: Avatar of Ghyran
options.lore_text: This gargant is a living pillar of life energy, making them quite difficult to kill.
options.effect: Heal (1) this unit.

options.name: Smashy
options.lore_text: This titan made their name by kicking over and trashing anything they didn’t like the look of.
options.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
options.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the target is a MONSTER, inflict D6 mortal damage on it instead.

options.name: Eager
options.lore_text: This gargant can’t wait to get stuck in.
options.declare: Pick the nearest visible enemy unit to this unit to be the target.
options.effect: For the rest of the turn:You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.This unit must end charge moves within ½" of the target.

options.name: Spell-Gobbler
options.lore_text: This titan has developed a taste for hostile magics and energies of the land.
options.effect: If this unit is not a WIZARD or PRIEST, while it is within 3" of a Place of Power or wholly within enemy territory, it can use Unbind and BANISH abilities as if it had WIZARD (1). Otherwise, add 1 to chanting rolls and casting rolls for this unit while it is within 3" of a Place of Power.

options.name: Awful Promise
options.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any HERO Phase
options.lore_text: This gargant points at the ‘snacks’ they intend to gobble down first, which is off-putting to those singled out, to say the least.
options.declare: Pick up to 3 visible enemy HEROES within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for each target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Behemat’s Fury
options.lore_text: This gargant is a furnace of bubbling rage that can flare up at any moment.
options.effect: Each time an attack made with this unit’s Almighty Stomp scores a critical hit, that attack scores 2 hits on the target unit instead of 1. Make a wound roll for each hit. In addition, if this unit has not charged in the same turn, those attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 4+.

options.name: Ghyranite Bastion
options.lore_text: This titan has grappled, beaten and eaten the biggest and best the Mortal Realms has to offer. Flushed with life energy, nothing keeps them down for long.
options.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (D6) this unit.

options.name: Siphon Spirit
options.lore_text: This champion possesses the ability to drain the animus from nearby thralls.
options.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Allocate D3 damage points to the target (ward rolls cannot be made), then Heal (D3) this unit.

options.name: Unholy Strength
options.lore_text: In death, this warrior has been granted blasphemous strength, each swing of their weapon making a mockery of even the stoutest protection.
options.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.

options.name: Protection of Shyish
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
options.lore_text: This Gravelord is surrounded by a sinister aura that shields them from all things holy and righteous.
options.effect: This unit has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Shadowy Translocation
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
options.lore_text: Swirling darkness swallows this undead chainpion before they reappear where the enemy least expects.
options.effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the balllefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

options.name: Hexed Weapons
options.lore_text: This warrior's gheist-touched weapons bear spectral edges that enable them to easily cleave through the defences of their target.
options.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

options.name: Cold Commander
options.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared the 'All-out Attack' command for a friendly unit
options.lore_text: This warrior is a ruthlesstaskmaster who drives their legions ever forward.
options.effect: If this unit is wholly within 12" of the unit using the ’All-out Attack’ command, no command points are spent to use that command.

options.name: Curse-Bound Sentinel
options.lore_text: The necrotic power that binds this warrior's undead form is stronger when they are near the site that holds their mortal remains.
options.effect: While this unit is wholly within friendly territory, unmodified save rolls of 4+ for it are always successful.

options.name: Eternal Champion
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
options.lore_text: This warrior is cursed never to rest while Nagash's foes still stand.
options.declare: This unit can use this ability if it has been destroyed.
options.effect: Roll 2D6. On a 7+, set up a replacement unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

options.name: The Vigilant Dead
options.lore_text: These undead warriors stand unyielding in the face of the enemy, giving no quarter to the living.
options.effect: Add 5 to this unit’s control score.

options.name: Relentless Shamblers
options.lore_text: Cursed to never know rest, these warriors pursue their enemies without a moment's pause.
options.effect: Add 1" to this unit's Move characteristic.

options.name: Unholy Presence
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: The fell aura that shrouds these undead warriors is of such malevolence that it burns the souls of the righteous.
options.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the target is a PRIEST, inflict 3 mortal damage on it instead.

options.name: The Restless Dead
options.lore_text: These undead warriors are cursed to return to the battlefield in an endless cycle until the enemies of the Great Necromancer are silenced.
options.effect: Return 1 slain model to this unit.

options.name: Empowered By Shyish
options.lore_text: A boon from the Great Necromancer is said to have been gifted to these warriors, warding them from the attacks of the enemy.
options.effect: This unit has WARD (5+).

options.name: Withering Touch
options.lore_text: Mere contact with these accursed undead causes weapons and armour to corrode as if they had seen the passing of aeons.
options.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

options.name: Cursed Weapons
options.lore_text: Bearing weapons imbued with fell enchantments, these warriors leave their victim's very souls scarred with each strike.
options.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).

options.name: Doomed Warriors
options.lore_text: These warriors are doomed to rise again and again, their sentence to serve the Undying King until they are naught but dust.
options.effect: When a replacement unit is set up for this unit, it has the same abilities from the 'Path of the Revenant' as this unit. In addition, this unit can return as a replacement unit any number of times during the battle.

options.name: Indomitable Soul
options.lore_text: Reforging has only enhanced this warrior's exceptional toughness.
options.effect: Add 1 to this unit’s Health characteristic.

options.name: Strength of the Tempest
options.lore_text: Their natural brawn means that this warrior hits harder than most.
options.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks.

options.name: Noble Defender
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
options.lore_text: This warrior stands at the head of their brethren, inspiring them to stand firm.
options.effect: For the rest of the turn, if a friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ’All-out Defence’ command, no command points are spent.

options.name: Lightning-Wreathed Weapons
options.lore_text: Raw Azyrite energy dances across the weapons of this hero, unleashing t/ie fury of the storm upon their enemies.
options.effect: Thls unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).

options.name: The God-King's Favour
options.lore_text: lt is said this warrior has once entered the inner chambers of Sigmaron and knelt in the presence of the God-King. Now, they bear his blessing in battle.
options.effect: This unit has WARD (5+).

options.name: Celestial Halo
options.lore_text: Crackling lightning arcs out at enemies who venture close to this warrior.
options.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be targets.
options.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

options.name: Bold Tactician
options.timing: Reaction: You declared the ’Counter-charge’ command for this unit
options.lore_text: This legendary warrior knows precisely when to signal the charge. For Sigmar!
options.effect: Pick another friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. After the ’Counter-charge’ command for this unit has been resolved, if this unit charged, the target can immediately use the ’Counter-charge’ command without any command points being spent.

options.name: Sigmar's Judgement
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
options.lore_text: At a critical moment in the battle, this mighty warrior steps up to the challenge and brings the fury of the God-King to the battlefield.
options.effect: This unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Heralds of the Tempest
options.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
options.lore_text: These warriors are oft among the first to strike down upon the battlefield in bolts of holy lightning, and they waste no time in charging into the fray.
options.effect: If this unit was set up on the battlefield using the ’Scions of the Storm’ ability this turn, add 1 to charge rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Mighty Reclaimers
options.lore_text: With great fury, these warriors drive the enemy back from those lands that once fell within Sigmar's ancient empire.
options.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by this unit that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective.

options.name: Blaze of Glory
options.lore_text: As these warriors are struck down, Sigmar's lightning wreaks devastation around them before they return to the heavens to be Reforged.
options.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

options.name: Speed of the Storm
options.lore_text: Like a flash of lightning, these warriors give their quarry no time to react as they race to deliver the God-King's vengeance.
options.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of this unit.

options.name: Blessed By Azyr
options.lore_text: These warriors exhibit a particular harmony with Azyrite magic and can draw upon its ambient energies to heal their wounds.
options.effect: Heal (D3) this unit.

options.name: Defensive Mastery
options.lore_text: When these warriors resolve to stand firm, they form an unyielding line akin to the soaring mountain ranges of High Azyr.
options.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit has STRIKE-LAST and WARD (4+).

options.name: Lightning-Wreathed Weapons
options.lore_text: Raw Azyrite energy dances across the weapons of these warriors.
options.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).

options.name: Indomitable Souls
options.lore_text: Reforging has only enhanced the exceptional toughness of these warriors.
options.effect: Add 1 to this unit’s Health characteristic.

options.name: Natural Regeneration
options.lore_text: Glowing sap oozes from this hero’s wounds and quickly seals them.
options.effect: When using the ‘Endless Growth’ ability, do not roll a D3 for this unit. Instead, Heal (3) this unit.

options.name: Song of Spite
options.lore_text: The haunting war cry of this forest spirit is enough to chill the blood of any foe.
options.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit if this unit charged in the same turn.

options.name: Territorial
options.lore_text: Enemies who dare trespass in the domain of this spirit are unlikely to survive long.
options.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks while it is wholly within the creeping overgrowth.

options.name: Jade Exemplar
options.lore_text: The caster channels the energy of life to enhance their magical capabilities.
options.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls and banishment rolls for this unit while it is wholly within the creeping overgrowth.

options.name: Barkscarred
options.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: This unit was picked to be the target of a non-CORE ability
options.lore_text: Having sustained and healed innumerable wounds, this spirit’s barkflesh has grown knotted and thick.
options.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

options.name: Bountiful Radiance
options.lore_text: As this spirit traverses the battlefield, the ground sprouts with an abundance of new life.
options.effect: You can measure the creeping overgrowth range from this unit.

options.name: Song of the Land
options.lore_text: This Sylvaneth’s accompaniments to the spirit-song imbue nearby flora with boundless life and abundance. At their will, once-barren features of the landscape are suddenly swallowed up beneath twisting lattices of vines, glistening blankets of moss and sweeping banks of swaying grass.
options.effect: Give every objective and terrain feature within 18" of this unit an overgrown token. You can measure the creeping overgrowth from objectives that have a friendly overgrown token.

options.name: Trick of the Dark
options.lore_text: This mercurial Sylvaneth is a master of camouflage and misleading trespassers in their shady forest domain.
options.declare: Pick a friendly Awakened Wyldwood to be the target.
options.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of this unit, more than 1" from all enemy units and other terrain features and more than 3" from all objectives. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within the creeping overgrowth and more than 9" from all enemy units.

options.name: Entangling Vines
options.lore_text: Grasping tendrils coil and writhe on the floor around these Sylvaneth, ensnaring the foe and preventing their escape.
options.effect: Enemy non-MONSTER units cannot use RETREAT abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

options.name: Envoys of the Everqueen
options.lore_text: These warriors have been tasked with a mission by Alarielle herself and bear her protective blessing.
options.effect: This unit has WARD (6+) while it is wholly within the creeping overgrowth.

options.name: Entangling Vines
options.lore_text: These Sylvaneth can make small jumps along the spirit paths in combat, taking foes by surprise with their sudden relocation.
options.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can make a pile-in move. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

options.name: Envoys of the Everqueen
options.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
options.lore_text: These Sylvaneth have formed a bond with a colony of magic-refracting lunar spites that flutter around them, diffusing and redirecting hostile arcane energies.
options.effect: If this unit was picked to be a target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit.

options.name: Carpet of Thorns
options.lore_text: These Sylvaneth have developed the skill of summoning tangles of thorny growths in the path of the foe to slow their advance.
options.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
options.effect: Subtract D3 from charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

options.name: The Old Stag’s Roar
options.lore_text: This Kurnothi horn reverberates ever louder as the foe are culled, imbuing its keepers with the rising thrill of the chase.
options.effect: Add the number of enemy units that have been destroyed this battle to this unit’s Move characteristic, to a maximum of +4".

options.name: Ceaseless Growth
options.lore_text: These Sylvaneth are true paladins of Ghyran, verdant champions that abound with the life-giving energies of the Jade Realm.
options.effect: When using the ‘Endless Growth’ ability, add X to the D3 roll for this unit, where X is the number of terrain features within 12" of this unit that have a friendly overgrown token.

options.name: Sacred Pursuit
options.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
options.lore_text: Those who have dedicated themselves to the hunt perceive trails hidden to most.
options.effect: If this unit is not in combat and has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within the creeping overgrowth and more than 9" from all enemy units.
